strategy.thesis: Global, multi-sector VC (€2.5B AUM, founded 2015, Paris HQ) with a dedicated Digital Health practice; targets AI applied to diagnostics, drug discovery and care affordability/access. Digital-health portfolio of 15 companies includes Owkin, Nabla, Bioptimus, AQEMIA, Sidecar Health, Resilience, and Qualified Health, with industry partners Sanofi, MACSF and BioMérieux.

summary.en: Paris-headquartered global VC (founded 2015, €2.5B AUM) with a dedicated Digital Health sector practice and a 15-company health/biotech portfolio (Owkin, Nabla, Bioptimus, AQEMIA, Resilience, Qualified Health among others). New Series B investor in Qualified Health (2026).

sources.quote: Founding Date: 2015. Headquarters: Paris. AUM: €2.5 billion. Focus Areas: AI, Robotics/IoT, Crypto, Digital Health, Fintech, Consumer/Retail, Energy/Mobility.

sources.title: Cathay Innovation — Digital Health
sources.supports: digital health portfolio, thesis, industry partners
sources.quote: startups using AI to solve healthcare's biggest pain points — from soaring costs and clinical inefficiencies to slow R&D cycles. Portfolio: Owkin, Nabla, Bioptimus, Nelly, Inato, Sidecar Health, Updoc, Savana, AQEMIA, Tucuvi, Medwing, Yuanbao Insurance, Clivi, Qualified Health, Resilience. Industry Partners: Sanofi, MACSF, BioMérieux.

verification_notes: Not to be confused with the unrelated Taiwanese entity 'Cathay Venture Capital / 國泰創業投資' (tw-cathay-venture-capital, part of Taiwan's Cathay Financial Holding) already in the roster — Cathay Innovation is a separate, Paris-headquartered global fund. Sanofi/MACSF/BioMérieux are listed as 'industry partners' on the digital-health sector page; whether they are LPs or co-investment partners is not confirmed, so no backer entries were added for them.
